payload.note: All four sprint-2 tickets designed, coded, reviewed, and merged, delivering Epic E2 (Document Processing Pipeline): plain text ingestion, PDF text extraction, chunking (LangChain RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter per ADR-9), and chunk validation with a single documentPipeline entry point. E2-T02 and E2-T03 were coded and reviewed in parallel in separate git worktrees once E2-T01 (shared types/errors) merged, since they only depend on E2-T01 and not each other; E2-T04 depended on all three and was coded sequentially afterward, split into two stacked PRs (chunkValidation.service.ts, then documentPipeline.service.ts) per design.md's own line-count guidance. New ADRs: ADR-9 (chunking library/strategy), ADR-10 (pdf-parse v2 API), ADR-11 (per-page segment metadata model).
